name: ai-intel-collector
description: Local AI industry first-party intel collector.

scripts.task:status: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AI Intel Collector Daily' | Select-Object TaskName,State,TaskPath | Format-List; $task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AI Intel Collector Daily'; $task.Triggers | Select-Object Enabled,DaysInterval,StartBoundary | Format-List"
scripts.task:enable: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Enable-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AI Intel Collector Daily' | Out-Null; Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AI Intel Collector Daily' | Select-Object TaskName,State | Format-List"
scripts.task:disable: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AI Intel Collector Daily' | Out-Null; Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AI Intel Collector Daily' | Select-Object TaskName,State | Format-List"
